policies.check:
((action = 'candidate.scan_applied'::text) AND (client_type = 'api'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs job
  WHERE (((job.id)::text = current_setting('eps.candidate_apply.job_id'::text, true)) AND (job.requested_by = audit_events.principal_id)))))

policies.name: frame_apply_audit
policies.check:
((action = 'candidate.frames_extracted'::text) AND (client_type = 'api'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs j
  WHERE (((j.id)::text = current_setting('eps.frame_apply.job_id'::text, true)) AND (j.kind = 'frame_extract'::text) AND (j.requested_by = audit_events.principal_id)))))

((action = 'jobs.apply_specs'::text) AND (client_type = 'api'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

constraints.name: media_assets_typed_purpose_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((
CASE purpose
    WHEN 'client_logo'::text THEN ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['image/png'::text, 'image/jpeg'::text, 'image/webp'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 5242880)) AND (source_asset_id IS NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (output_stage IS NULL) AND (output_key IS NULL) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (width IS NOT NULL) AND (height IS NOT NULL) AND (((width)::bigint * (height)::bigint) <= 40000000))))
    WHEN 'specs'::text THEN ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['application/pdf'::text, 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'::text, 'text/plain'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (output_stage IS NULL) AND (output_key IS NULL) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))
    WHEN 'document_text'::text THEN ((mime_type = 'application/json'::text) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (output_stage = 'prepare_document'::text) AND (output_key = 'document_text'::text) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))
    WHEN 'candidate_video'::text THEN ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['video/mp4'::text, 'video/quicktime'::text, 'video/webm'::text, 'video/x-matroska'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 268435456)) AND (bucket = 'eps-candidate-assets'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (output_stage IS NULL) AND (output_key IS NULL) AND (source_timestamp_ms IS NULL) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND ((width >= 1) AND (width <= 4096)) AND ((height >= 1) AND (height <= 4096)) AND ((duration_ms >= 1) AND (duration_ms <= 1800000)))))
    WHEN 'audio'::text THEN ((mime_type = 'audio/mpeg'::text) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND (source_timestamp_ms IS NULL) AND (bucket = 'eps-candidate-outputs'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (output_stage = 'prepare_candidate'::text) AND ((length(output_key) >= 1) AND (length(output_key) <= 100)) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))
    WHEN 'transcript'::text THEN ((mime_type = 'application/json'::text) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 2097152)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND (source_timestamp_ms IS NULL) AND (duration_ms IS NULL) AND (bucket = 'eps-candidate-outputs'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (output_stage = 'transcribe_candidate'::text) AND ((length(output_key) >= 1) AND (length(output_key) <= 100)) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))
    WHEN 'candidate_frame'::text THEN ((mime_type = 'image/jpeg'::text) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (duration_ms IS NULL) AND (bucket = 'eps-candidate-outputs'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (output_stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare_candidate'::text, 'extract_frames'::text])) AND ((length(output_key) >= 1) AND (length(output_key) <= 100)) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND ((width >= 1) AND (width <= 4096)) AND ((height >= 1) AND (height <= 4096)) AND ((source_timestamp_ms >= 0) AND (source_timestamp_ms <= 1800000)))))
    WHEN 'candidate_support'::text THEN ((bucket = 'eps-candidate-support'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (output_stage IS NULL) AND (output_key IS NULL) AND (source_timestamp_ms IS NULL) AND (duration_ms IS NULL) AND (((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['image/png'::text, 'image/jpeg'::text, 'image/webp'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 5242880)) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (width > 0) AND (height > 0) AND (((width)::bigint * (height)::bigint) <= 40000000)))) OR ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['application/pdf'::text, 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'::text, 'text/plain'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))))
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE))

constraints.name: media_assets_typed_purpose_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((
CASE purpose
    WHEN 'client_logo'::text THEN ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['image/png'::text, 'image/jpeg'::text, 'image/webp'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 5242880)) AND (source_asset_id IS NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (output_stage IS NULL) AND (output_key IS NULL) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (width IS NOT NULL) AND (height IS NOT NULL) AND (((width)::bigint * (height)::bigint) <= 40000000))))
    WHEN 'specs'::text THEN ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['application/pdf'::text, 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'::text, 'text/plain'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (output_stage IS NULL) AND (output_key IS NULL) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))
    WHEN 'document_text'::text THEN ((mime_type = 'application/json'::text) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (output_stage = 'prepare_document'::text) AND (output_key = 'document_text'::text) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))
    WHEN 'candidate_video'::text THEN ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['video/mp4'::text, 'video/quicktime'::text, 'video/webm'::text, 'video/x-matroska'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 268435456)) AND (bucket = 'eps-candidate-assets'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (output_stage IS NULL) AND (output_key IS NULL) AND (source_timestamp_ms IS NULL) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND ((width >= 1) AND (width <= 4096)) AND ((height >= 1) AND (height <= 4096)) AND ((duration_ms >= 1) AND (duration_ms <= 1800000)))))
    WHEN 'audio'::text THEN ((mime_type = 'audio/mpeg'::text) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND (source_timestamp_ms IS NULL) AND (bucket = 'eps-candidate-outputs'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (output_stage = 'prepare_candidate'::text) AND ((length(output_key) >= 1) AND (length(output_key) <= 100)) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))
    WHEN 'transcript'::text THEN ((mime_type = 'application/json'::text) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 2097152)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND (source_timestamp_ms IS NULL) AND (duration_ms IS NULL) AND (bucket = 'eps-candidate-outputs'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (output_stage = 'transcribe_candidate'::text) AND ((length(output_key) >= 1) AND (length(output_key) <= 100)) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))
    WHEN 'candidate_frame'::text THEN ((mime_type = 'image/jpeg'::text) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (duration_ms IS NULL) AND (bucket = 'eps-candidate-outputs'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NOT NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (output_stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare_candidate'::text, 'extract_frames'::text])) AND ((length(output_key) >= 1) AND (length(output_key) <= 100)) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND ((width >= 1) AND (width <= 4096)) AND ((height >= 1) AND (height <= 4096)) AND ((source_timestamp_ms >= 0) AND (source_timestamp_ms <= 1800000)))))
    WHEN 'candidate_support'::text THEN ((bucket = 'eps-candidate-support'::text) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_asset_id IS NULL) AND (producing_job_id IS NULL) AND (producing_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (output_stage IS NULL) AND (output_key IS NULL) AND (source_timestamp_ms IS NULL) AND (duration_ms IS NULL) AND (((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['image/png'::text, 'image/jpeg'::text, 'image/webp'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 5242880)) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (width > 0) AND (height > 0) AND (((width)::bigint * (height)::bigint) <= 40000000)))) OR ((mime_type = ANY (ARRAY['application/pdf'::text, 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'::text, 'text/plain'::text])) AND ((size_bytes >= 1) AND (size_bytes <= 20971520)) AND (width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL) AND ((status <> 'ready'::text) OR (sha256 IS NOT NULL)))))
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE))
